🚀 We’re hiring Senior & Lead AI/ML talent!

📍 Colombia or Chile
🏠 100% remote within the country
🙂  Senior & Lead opportunities

At SoftServe, I’m currently looking for experienced professionals for 100% remote opportunities within Colombia or Chile.

🎯 For these opportunities, we’re particularly looking for strong production experience.
We’re interested in professionals who have worked end-to-end on AI/ML solutions, from the initial idea and design through deployment, production, monitoring and scaling.

Experience with PoCs and prototypes is valuable, but for these roles, we’re specifically looking for professionals who have also had the opportunity to take solutions beyond the PoC stage and work with them in real production environments at scale.

We’re especially interested in people who can demonstrate hands-on experience with:
Discovery & requirements → solution design → development → deployment → production → monitoring → scaling

In other words, we want to hear about solutions that made it to production and operated at scale in real environments.
